# ICellRange.getFormulas

```ts
/**
 * Returns the formula text of every cell in the range.
 *
 * @returns A row-major 2D array in the shape of the range.
 *
 * @remarks
 * - Each formula reads as entered, with its leading `=` (`'=SUM(A1:A3)'`), so the result can be
 *   passed straight back to {@link ICellRange.setFormulas}.
 * - A cell without a formula reads as an empty string `''`, not `null`. This differs from
 *   {@link ICell.getFormulaText} and {@link ICellRange.getFormula}, which return `null`.
 * - Throws if the range holds more than `10000` cells, like {@link ICellRange.getValues}.
 *
 * @see {@link ICellRange.getFormula}
 */
getFormulas(): string[][];
```
